scenes.sub: Pass an argument through a template exactly as it came in.
scenes.say: Perfect forwarding. A template takes an argument and passes it on to another function, keeping it an lvalue if it was an lvalue, and an rvalue if it was an rvalue. First, the problem.

scenes.head: The problem: the rvalue gets lost
scenes.say: Two overloads of take: one copies, one moves. A wrapper template passes its argument along. Pass s, and it copies, which is right. Pass a temporary, and it should move. But it prints copy twice. Inside the wrapper, arg has a name, so it's an lvalue, and the rvalue-ness is lost.

scenes.head: The fix: std::forward

steps.cue: s t d forward of T

scenes.say: Two ingredients. First, a parameter of type T and and, where T is deduced. That's a forwarding reference, and it accepts anything. Second, s t d forward of T, which casts arg back to an rvalue only if an rvalue was passed in. Now it prints copy, then move. Exactly what the caller meant.

scenes.head: How T remembers: deduction + reference collapsing

items.cue: T is deduced as string ampersand

arrows.cue: T is deduced as string ampersand

scenes.say: How does T remember? Pass the lvalue s, and T is deduced as string ampersand. Reference collapsing turns ampersand plus and and into a plain lvalue reference, and forward returns an lvalue. Pass a temporary, and T is just string, so arg is string and and, and forward casts to an rvalue. The category is encoded in T.

scenes.head: Where you see it, and the traps
scenes.say: This is how make unique and emplace back pass your constructor arguments through without extra copies. Traps: only T and and, with T deduced right there, is a forwarding reference. A vector of int and and, or const T and and, is just an rvalue reference. And forward an argument only once, since forwarding an rvalue twice can move from it twice.

lines: Perfect forwarding: pass arguments on with their value category intact.
Needs a forwarding reference T&& (T deduced) plus std::forward<T>.
Used by make_unique, emplace_back, and other wrappers.
scenes.say: Perfect forwarding passes arguments on with their lvalue or rvalue category intact. It needs a forwarding reference, T and and with T deduced, plus s t d forward of T. It's how make unique and emplace back avoid needless copies.
